build: version 1.0, eight D64 images (archive.org d64_Pool_of_Radiance_v1.0_1988_SSI_Disk_1_of_4_Side_A); BOOT prints "POOL OF RADIANCE, VERSION 1.0"

comments.text: SQRPACI64, the temple's code and its price list, which post-com's heal ($209C) loads into slot 1 at $0400 for HEAL at a temple. This first routine: carry set when the member's condition ($6C00 AND $7F) is 1, OK, or 5, UNCONSCIOUS, the only two the wound cures help; otherwise cannot_help. A member DYING (4) is turned away.
THAT SPELL CAN NOT HELP YOU (message $0E) on the bottom row (show_msg), carry clear.
A is the hit points after a cure: when it reaches the full hit points ($6B76, low byte) or more, the hit points ($6C19) become the full figure. A lower figure is left as heal_amount stored it.
The cure's roll (heal_roll, $2B5B) added to the hit points ($6C19, low byte), at most 255, held to the full figure (cap_hp), and the condition made OK (1), so an unconscious member comes round.

The wound cures' common end, with their roll in A, kept in heal_roll ($2B5B). A member the cure cannot help (can_heal) pays nothing (no_cure); any other is healed (heal_amount) and pays (post-com cured, $22C2).

The price of each menu item in gold pieces, low bytes, items 0 to 10 in the menu's order: CURE BLINDNESS 1000, CURE DISEASE 1000, CURE LIGHT WOUNDS 100, CURE SERIOUS WOUNDS 350, CURE CRITICAL WOUNDS 600, item 5 5000, NEUTRALIZE POISON 1000, RAISE DEAD 5500, REMOVE CURSE 3500, item 9 20000, STONE TO FLESH 2000. Items 5 and 9 are named @ in the menu (menu_text), which the menu's mask hides.
The prices' high bytes, in the same order.

Called by post-com's heal for the cure picked (temple_choice, $2B59): the member's name at row 2, the cure's name at row 4 (cure_text_lo, cure_text_hi), then WILL COST (message $0F), the price (price_lo, price_hi) and GOLD PIECES (message $2B). The bar PAY FOR CURE: YES NO (pay_bar). NO, or leaving the bar, returns carry clear. YES returns carry set when the member can pay (can_afford); when it cannot, the pool's money is lent (post-com add_pool, $177A) and it tries again; still short, NOT ENOUGH MONEY ! (message $23), the pool's money goes back (post-com return_pool, $17A8) and carry clear.
The bar's heading and items for menu_bar: 2 items, PAY FOR CURE:, then YES and NO, each ending in 0.
The pool's money given back if it was lent (post-com return_pool, $17A8), and nothing paid.
CURE LIGHT WOUNDS: a roll of 1d8 (roll_dice), then cure_wounds.
CURE SERIOUS WOUNDS: 2d8.

CURE CRITICAL WOUNDS: 3d8. Both rolls then add $6DB8, roll_dice's count of the dice still to roll, which the roll has just counted down to 0, so the bonus is always 0: 2 to 16 and 3 to 24. Then cure_wounds.

RAISE DEAD: only for a member DEAD (condition 3, AND 7), and not for race 0 (a monster), 2 (an elf) or 6 (a half-orc): the others get THAT SPELL CAN NOT HELP YOU (cannot_cure) and pay nothing. The money is taken before the roll (post-com cured, $22C2). A roll of 0 to 99 (random_to) at or above the chance for the member's constitution (survival) fails: raise_failed.

Raised: constitution ($6B18) one lower, the condition OK and 1 hit point. The full hit points are worked out again with the new constitution: its bonus (con_bonus) times the level shown ($6BA0), plus the rolls without constitution ($6BED). A zombie of ANIMATE DEAD is put back as a party member (unzombie), the combat figures rebuilt (compute_combat_stats), the member stored, and its name with IS ALIVE (message $1C), then PRESS <RETURN> (post-com press_return, $1822).
The raise failed: the member is GONE ($82), stored, and FAILED (message $1F). The money stays paid.
THAT SPELL CAN NOT HELP YOU (cannot_help) and nothing paid (no_cure): the end of every cure that finds nothing to do.

The hit points each level gets from constitution ($6B18): 0 below 15; from 15, a fighter's (class mask $6BEB bit 3) from con_hp_fighter, anyone else's from con_hp_other. The tables are gen's (con_bonus_fighter, $248A).
A fighter: con_hp_fighter read from $0575 plus the constitution, so the table begins 15 places on, at $0584.
Anyone else: con_hp_other read from $0580 plus the constitution, from $058F.
A fighter's hit points a level for constitution 15 to 25: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6, 7, 7.
Anyone else's for constitution 15 to 25: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5.

After a raise, for a member that holds ANIMATE DEAD's kind 32 ($20, has_item_type): that kind's place in its ten kinds cleared ($6BAD + X, X as has_item_type left it), the levels lost ($6BA1) and its type ($6BD7) 0, movement 12 ($6B9F), the NPC byte ($6BB8) back to 0 or 1 from the $FE or $FF ANIMATE DEAD made of it, its sweeps ($6B98) the fighter level ($6BCC) again, and its turning level ($6BA4) from the cleric level (turn_levels). A member with no kind 32 is left as it is.
The turning level ($6BA4) for cleric levels 0 to 8: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, as gen's cleric_figures.

Meant to start a count of effects ended (ended_count, $2B5A) and end the timed effects of kind A, but its LDA #$00 replaces the kind in A before end_kind runs. So it ends no effect of the kind asked for: with A 0, find_entry, which searches the 64 entries from the last down, matches the first empty entry it meets, which end_kind empties again and counts. CURE BLINDNESS loses kind $21 this way, and CURE DISEASE kind $22.
Ends the party's timed effect of kind A held by the member ($6DB4) or by nobody (find_entry): its kind set to 0, and ended_count ($2B5A) one higher. Carry clear when there was none.

CURE BLINDNESS: meant to end kinds $21, $2F and $30. Kind $21, CAUSE BLINDNESS's, is lost in end_first_kind; $2F and $30 are kinds that no spell's record gives. With anything counted, and the empty entry end_first_kind counts is nearly always there, the cure is paid for (post-com cured, $22C2); otherwise cannot_cure.

CURE DISEASE: meant to end kinds $22, $32, $2B, $2C and $39, and $1F after them: the six the party's spell ends (camp-spells disease_kinds, $9B2C). Kind $22 (34), CAUSE DISEASE's, is lost in end_first_kind. Then the condition's bit 5 ($20, read from disease_bit) is counted when set and cleared: the IS DISEASED of the mummy's rot. Then kind $1F (31), the helpless, ended when the member holds it (has_item_type). Paid for when anything was counted (post-com cured, $22C2), otherwise cannot_cure.

NEUTRALIZE POISON: only for a member that holds the poison, kind $37 (has_item_type); otherwise cannot_cure. The kind's place cleared ($6BAD + X). A member whose condition ($6C00 AND $7F) is 9, as SLOW POISON leaves it, is made OK (1), and its timed effects of kinds $16 (SLOW POISON), $2C and $0F (the poison's damage) ended. Then it pays (post-com cured, $22C2).
STONE TO FLESH: only for a member STONED (condition 7, AND 7): made OK (1) and it pays (post-com cured, $22C2); otherwise cannot_cure.

REMOVE CURSE: each of the member's 16 items ($6DAD from 15 down, load_item_slot) that is readied ($6D82 bit 7) and cursed ($6D83 bit 7) is made unready and stored (store_item), and counted; the curse stays on the item. Then BESTOW CURSE's timed effect, kind $24, ended (end_kind). Paid for when anything was counted (post-com cured, $22C2), otherwise cannot_cure.

RAISE DEAD's chance in 100 for constitution 0 to 25: 0 for 0 to 6, then 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 92, 94, 96, 98 and 100 for 7 to 18, and 100 above. Items 5 and 9 of the price list have this table as their routine (post-com temple_lo, $20F8), which the menu's mask never lets them reach.

Carry set when the member can pay for the cure picked: its coins in copper (post-com money_total, $12E8) against the price (price_lo, price_hi) times 200, the copper in a gold piece (post-com mul_24 and can_pay_24).

The menu for build_menu (resident $3CC3): 12 items, column 2, row 9, then the items, each ending in 0: CURE BLINDNESS, CURE DISEASE, CURE LIGHT WOUNDS, CURE SERIOUS WOUNDS, CURE CRITICAL WOUNDS, @, NEUTRALIZE POISON, RAISE DEAD, REMOVE CURSE, @, STONE TO FLESH and EXIT. Post-com's heal shows it with the mask $FDDF, whose clear bits hide items 5 and 9, the two named @.
Each menu item's text, low bytes, for ask_price: $070B, $071A and on to EXIT's $079F.
The texts' high bytes, all $07.
$20, the bit of the condition that cure_disease tests (with BIT) and clears: IS DISEASED.
